differences.statement: All retained rows require stable role/database binding before semantic comparison; no mismatch waiver or guessed identity.

missingObservations.missing: Index definitions/validity/predicates/expressions and view/materialized-view definitions, owners, options and ACLs were not captured. Constraint-backed index identity alone does not cover independent indexes.
Column collation, identity/generated attributes, storage/compression and attribute order were not all retained. Defaults are hashes; differing hashes require canonical expressions.
Full table persistence/partition/inheritance/options and sequence definitions/ownership were not retained.

Only five expected ingestion membership paths and aggregate counts were retained. Full member/grantor identities and every relevant transitive membership edge need stable sanitized identifiers plus admin/inherit/set options; no login passwords.

Stored table/column/default ACLs are retained; complete effective mutation privileges through all inherited roles and global default ACL owner/schema scope require the full membership graph and canonical grant expansion.
All retained hosted observations are dated. Refresh exact baseline/objects and bounded relevant configuration at the future authorized release preflight; no owner data is needed.

statement: A match covers only retained fields. All differences remain review items; provider labels do not waive a security or recovery gate.
